name: 30th-celebration
_paths: Relative paths resolve against the repo root. backRef is made by recolour-back.cjs (step ref) from the 151 back with its live zones blanked.

back._comment: The 151 numbers moved by recolour.scale and the centring pad (recolour-back.cjs checks them). backRef pixels.

_pixelTuned: feather, rim and seamTexMargin are 151's values times 0.885 (this front is 1474 px tall, 151's 1666). strip.rimBand [2,12] and rimBlur 30 sample only the front's neon edge line, smoothed: at [4,30] Pikachu's tail and the gold stripes, which reach this front's right edge, turned the back's strip into yellow blocks.

recolour._scale: front body width 674.3 px / 151's 856.5 px: the 151 text block (815 px) only fits scaled

targets._calibration: ground: set so the back ground patch (right panel, flat) relates to the front dark ground (L<22 median) as 151 does: L x0.95, chroma x0.645, hue -9 deg (harness-raw/ground-match.cjs measures it). pale = front pale (L>88) median, L -2.4. band: the front's yellow, pulled inside the sRGB gamut so the gloss does not clip.
targets._sampled: front: dark ground L<22 median Lab 4.1/3.6/-9.8 (hues 290-330); yellow peak h95-105 L90-96 C88-91 (#ffe316, #f6fd2a); pale L>88 median 96.3/0.0/-1.1 (#f3f4f6)
